title: Week 12
description: IIoT in oil, chemical and pharmaceutical industries, UAV applications, and real-world case studies

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of IoT in the oil and gas industry?
What is a key application of IoT sensors in the pharmaceutical industry?
Which of the following cannot be achieved by performing condition-based monitoring using IoT?
options: Analytics-based weather prediction and its impact on farming
Adjust the amount of required material

questions.question: How does IoT improve logistics for industries?
options: Preventing product location tracking with sensors or RFID tags
Ensuring contamination detection and alert notifications
Ignoring asset tracking to prevent loss

questions.question: How does IoT contribute to reducing energy expenses in industries?
options: By analyzing real-time data to identify inefficiencies

questions.question: Which of the following can be achieved by using IoT in the chemical industry?
Which generation of UAVs introduced transformable designs, 1080 HD video, and three-axis gimbals?
How do UAVs help in the mining industry?
How do UAVs help in agriculture?
options: Monitor crop stress factors like over-fertilization or drought

questions.question: What is a major advantage(s) of UAVs in telecommunication?
options: Monitor towers from any angle and height
Covers wide areas with less cost

questions.question: Which of the following is most suitable for scanning a huge number of items in a warehouse, checking the missing items, and monitoring full inventory?
Which generation of UAVs introduced transformable designs with 360° gimbals and high-quality video instrumentation?
Which of the following is NOT an application of UAVs in forestry?
options: Conducting forestry surveys to show information about forest species, including the humans around the forest
Precision forestry and canopy mapping for measuring canopy height, density, and volume estimation

questions.question: What is one of the primary applications of UAVs in construction sites?
Which of the following is/are FALSE about the necessity of case studies?
options: The case study investigates real-life phenomena through a detailed analysis of related events.
The case study generally selects a vast geographical area or a large number of individuals as the subject matter.
